traits.name: Martial Advantage.
traits.text: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 2d6 damage to one creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Longsword.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow.
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
